1: // Neon Runner – simple endless runner on a canvas with id="game"
2: // Click or tap to make the orb jump. Avoid moving barriers.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas present
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
10:   function resize() {
11:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
12:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
13:   }
14:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15:   resize();
16: 
17:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
18:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
19:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 12;
20:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
21:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 80; // vertical gap for the orb to pass
22:   const SPEED = 4;
23: 
24:   const player = { x: 60, y: canvas.height / 2, vy: 0, alive: true };
25:   let obstacles = [];
26:   let spawnTimer = 0;
27:   let score = 0;
28:   let lastTime = 0;
29: 
30:   function reset() {
31:     player.y = canvas.height / 2;
32:     player.vy = 0;
33:     player.alive = true;
34:     obstacles = [];
35:     spawnTimer = 0;
36:     score = 0;
37:     lastTime = performance.now();
38:   }
39: 
40:   function jump() {
41:     if (!player.alive) {
42:       reset();
43:       return;
44:     }
45:     player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
46:   }
47: 
48:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
49:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); }, { passive: false });
50: 
51:   function spawnObstacle() {
52:     const gapY = Math.random() * (canvas.height - OBSTACLE_GAP - 40) + 20;
53:     // top rect
54:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: 0, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: gapY });
55:     // bottom rect
56:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: gapY + OBSTACLE_GAP, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: canvas.height - (gapY + OBSTACLE_GAP) });
57:   }
58: 
59:   function update(dt) {
60:     if (!player.alive) return;
61:     // player physics
62:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
63:     player.y += player.vy;
64:     // floor/ceiling check
65:     if (player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > canvas.height || player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < 0) {
66:       player.alive = false;
67:     }
68:     // obstacles movement & spawn
69:     spawnTimer -= dt;
70:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
71:       spawnObstacle();
72:       spawnTimer = 1500; // ms until next
73:     }
74:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
75:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
76:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
77:     // collision detection
78:     for (const o of obstacles) {
79:       const withinX = player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > o.x && player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < o.x + o.w;
80:       const withinY = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > o.y && player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < o.y + o.h;
81:       if (withinX && withinY) {
82:         player.alive = false;
83:         break;
84:       }
85:     }
86:     // score based on time survived
87:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - lastTime) / 100);
88:   }
89: 
90:   function draw() {
91:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
92:     // background
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
94:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
95:     // player orb – neon glow
96:     ctx.save();
97:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
98:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
100:     ctx.beginPath();
101:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
102:     ctx.fill();
103:     ctx.restore();
104:     // obstacles – neon bars
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
106:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
107:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
108:     });
109:     // score
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
111:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
112:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
113:     if (!player.alive) {
114:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
115:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
116:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
117:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Click to Restart', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   function loop(timestamp) {
122:     const dt = timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp);
123:     lastTime = timestamp;
124:     update(dt);
125:     draw();
126:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127:   }
128: 
129:   reset();
130:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
131: })();
